title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Ballroom, U. of California on 1970-06-21
lineage: unknown transfer to WAV-1648 marked 2nd-Gen > Wavelab (small edits & speed adjust) > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1648 tagged.
source: AUD said to have been recorded by Harry Ely

ai_review.summary: Cavernous audience recording with echoey sound, but standout Easy Wind, Candyman and a rare NFA→St Stephen segue give it some merit despite an overall uneven performance.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an audience‑recorded show in a large hall that sounds reverberant and at times skippable, with no soundboard feed. Musically the concert offers highlights such as a shredding Easy Wind, Jerry’s moaning on Candyman, a strong St Stephen, and a novel The Other One → St Stephen transition that reviewers find worth repeated listens.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates the show very low due to poor recording quality, while another praises a unique song segue; overall performance is mixed and the audience source is only fair, leading to an average‑ish rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Echoey, cavernous hall sound with noticeable reverberation; no soundboard cut; audio improves deeper into the set but remains less clear than a typical soundboard recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert features an unusual NFA (The Other One) → St Stephen segue that flips the typical order, and it ends abruptly; overall pacing is uneven but contains strong moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His moaning on Candyman is noted positively.
band_member_comments.Drums: A gunshot/pistol sound appears during St Stephen, unclear if it’s a drum effect or a shotgun.
